title: Altium Identity access token claims
description: Decoded payload of an Altium 365 access token (JWT, typ=at+jwt, alg=RS256). Verify the signature against the issuer JWKS before trusting these claims.

iss.description: Issuer — identifies the environment/cloud, e.g. https://auth.altium.com (Commercial) or https://auth.365-gov.altium.com (Gov).

sub.description: Subject — for user tokens, the user ID.

client_id.description: The application (registered OAuth client) that obtained the token.

scope.description: Granted scopes. A workspace token includes a365:workspace:{workspaceId}; offline_access means a refresh token was issued.

workspaceId.description: Present on workspace tokens only — the workspace authId (matches the a365:workspace: scope).

secure.description: Present on GovCloud tokens only. Marks a Gov (secure) token; absent on Commercial tokens.

allOf.$comment: A workspace token (has workspaceId) must carry a matching a365:workspace scope.
